items.title: Veeva Systems’s (NYSE:VEEV) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates, Stock Soars
items.summary: Life sciences cloud software provider Veeva Systems (NYSE:VEEV) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 17.6% year on year to $928 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $933.5 million at the midpoint, 1.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.35 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
